fit_reason: Private owner selling a complete aluminum fishing boat with outboard and trailer.
findings: Debris and leaves scattered across the carpeted floor
Dark stains and blotches on the floor carpet near the console
White scuff and chalky marks on the black console box
Dull, weathered painted finish on the hull sides
Scuffed, faded paint around the transom corner near the motor
Dusty, dull finish on the outboard cowling
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Sea Nymph with the Mariner 20. The carpet has some leaves and dark stains near the console, and the hull paint looks a bit dull and scuffed at the transom. We do pre-sale details for boats, including carpet cleaning, a wash and polish, and small touch-ups, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
